step.action: Inspect each radio and battery for cracks, swelling, leaking, or unusual heat.
step.ifThen: IF damage or unusual heat is present, THEN do not charge that radio and tell the Dominatrix.

step.action: Connect each safe radio to its compatible charger.
Observe the charging indicator on each connected radio or charger.
step.ifThen: IF the charging indicator does not appear, THEN reconnect it once and tell the Dominatrix if it still does not charge.

step.action: Leave each radio fully charged or connected to a powered compatible charger.

passWhen.criterion: Every returned radio is accounted for.
Every safe radio is fully charged or visibly charging.
No damaged or unusually hot battery is charging.
